---
title: "Game Theory"
---

Salut! You can navigate yourself through one of the following topics:

1. [Normal-Form Games](normal.qmd)
   - How to describe a normal-form game? What are the implications?

2. [Extensive-Form Games](extensive.qmd)
   - What can happen if each player takes its turns?

3. [Repeated Games](repeated.qmd)
   - How to evaluate strategies when games are repeated finitely or infinitely?

4. [Bayesian Games](bayesian.qmd)
   - Players are best-responding to their own types and also their counterparts'.

5. [Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium](pbe.qmd)
   - A new equilibrium system based on beliefs.
